03 / CORE VALUES

Core values at
S7 Robotics.

We are FIRST LEGO League team #311311 from Aktau. We build robots, help other teams prepare and organize robotics competitions in our community.

01 / DISCOVERY

Explore the Caspian Sea

What could a robot tell us about the water off our coast? For CaspianGuard AI, we are exploring how to measure water temperature, depth and pH.

02 / INNOVATION

Design a boat for the job

Our CaspianGuard AI concept pairs a surface camera for spotting floating litter with an underwater camera for observing fish.

03 / IMPACT

Help other teams prepare

Our robotics school has helped more than 35 teams prepare for FIRST LEGO League and the World Robot Olympiad. S7 teams have earned the Help Hand Award and the Core Values Award.

04 / INCLUSION

Connect schools across Aktau

We work with four partner schools in Aktau, including NIS Aktau and Tanym. Independent teams also take part in our robotics community.

05 / TEAMWORK

Bring teams together

We have organized robotics competitions where teams can meet, run their robots and see how others approach the same challenge.

06 / FUN

Enjoy the robot game

Our competition robot is built. As we refine its programs, one of our favorite moments is watching it carry out a mission we have worked on together.
